name: What steps are involved in professional bathroom marble installation?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in professional bathroom marble installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process starts with tearing out old materials down to the studs and subfloor to inspect framing integrity. An uncoupling membrane or cement backer board is installed, followed by complete waterproofing in wet zones. The installer dry-lays marble tiles to arrange natural veining patterns attractively across the room. Next, tiles are set using white thin-set mortar spread evenly to prevent voids beneath the stone. After curing, joints are grouted with non-sanded or specialized stone grout to avoid scratching the polished or honed face. Finally, edges are caulked with color-matched silicone, and a penetrating stone sealer is applied across all surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes tear-out, structural prep, waterproofing, dry-fitting veins, setting with white thin-set, grouting, and applying an impregnating sealer.
